resolved_findings.detail: The existing contract test only asserted validator source strings while the dedicated gate had no negative fixture proving missing/blank/TBD rejection. Added executable in-memory negative self-tests that run on every matrix-governance gate.

The new executable self-test exposed that extract_material_field used \s*, which could cross a newline and treat the next field as the value of a blank field. Replaced newline-capable whitespace with horizontal [ \t]* matching so blank governed fields fail closed.
